name: diagram-layout-engine
description: A from-scratch layout engine for a Mermaid flowchart subset: recursive-descent parser with line/column errors, the full Sugiyama pipeline (greedy feedback arcs, longest-path or network-simplex layering, barycenter/median sweeps with transposition, Brandes-Kopf coordinates, spline/orthogonal routing), subgraphs with their own direction, themeable SVG, stable-layout visual diff, a stage-by-stage pipeline inspector and a 50-graph benchmark. Entirely client-side.
